lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits and pectoral fin, forming roughly horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect with the horizontal clusters of high-intensity blobs, creating discernible grid-like anchor points on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A non-uniform distribution of high-luminance circular blobs contained within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, showing higher density toward the anterior edge.
